Very good hamburgers
Aug 2018 • Friends
This a hip little restaurant with a good range of “Asian” cuisine although it’s the hamburgers that are the star attraction. The meat patties were moist with good flavour. Complimented by a classic salad and bun it makes for an enjoyable diversion from Vietnamese. But if you need a serve of pad Thai or mee goreng it’s also available. Only downside is service is slow.

The quality is plummeting
Sep 2016 • Solo
I have been a regular customer there for a few weeks, but the service and food quality are really going down. A few days ago, I ordered what's described on the menu as "Chicken cutlet with wasabi sauce," but was brought fish and chips.
 Tonight, I went back and told the woman owner about the problem last time. She gave me that big fake smile and apology (of course, no offer of any compensation in the slightest) that's so common in this region. Anyway, I ordered the chicken cutlet again. When it came, I saw that there was no wasabi at all, but a brown gravy with old mushrooms on top. The meat itself was rubbery, fatty, mostly inedible. A terrible meal. And I've noticed lately that, when I order lime juice as a drink, the amount they serve is gradually going lower below what should be the fill line. Tonight, I finally took the drink downstairs to Mrs. Owner to tell her about this, and to ask for more juice, as I've been a good regular customer and feel like I've been getting a bad deal. She gave me the "I'm so sad" routine.
 I went back upstairs to wait for a drink that was filled. A couple minutes later, I was brought a cup with more ice and less juice, so I brought it back downstairs and explained again, as the servers can't comprehend much at all. At the end of this bad experience with rubber chicken that's got nothing to do with wasabi, I went back down to pay my bill, and asked her about the missing wasabi. She gave a big laugh and said that the menu on the wall behind her is "old." That's it. 
Accountability? In Phu My Hung? Dream on ...
